tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App and page background. The warm unbleached-paper ground in light; the soil ground in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the notepad sheet, popovers and sheets that sit above paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, inset wells, the transcript rail, input fields at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons), meets 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the mark's bars, primary button fill (light). 15:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps in lists, helper text. 6.7:1 (light), 8:1 (dark) on paper.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Icons, placeholder glyphs, disabled labels at 24px+. Not for body text in light (3.4:1).

tokens.name: malt
tokens.usage: The brand amber: the cited bar in the mark, the i's tittle, primary accent fills, selection, the live waveform. Fill only, never text on paper in light (2.7:1).

tokens.name: malt-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text and lines: links, citation numbers, the 'Them' speaker label, focus rings. 5.6:1 (light), 10:1 (dark) on paper.

tokens.name: malt-tint
tokens.usage: Citation chip ground, highlighted transcript moment, selected list row. Pair with malt-ink text (4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-malt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a malt fill (5.7:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Never white on malt.

tokens.name: sprout
tokens.usage: Verified: a claim the checking step found in the transcript, offline/on-device status, success. 5.1:1 (light), 8.7:1 (dark) on paper.

tokens.name: sprout-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for verified badges and success notices, with sprout text.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Unverified or removed: an owner or deadline nobody said, 'not found in transcript', destructive actions. 5.5:1 (light), 7.2:1 (dark) on paper.

tokens.name: clay-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for flagged items and warnings, with clay text (4.8:1 light, 5.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: The recording dot only, always next to an ink 'Recording' label and a timer. Not a general error colour: use clay.

tokens.name: speaker-me
tokens.usage: Speaker label and gutter tick for 'Me' (your microphone).

tokens.name: speaker-them
tokens.usage: Speaker label and gutter tick for 'Them' (the call audio). Told apart from Me by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable control.

families.serif: Newsreader, "Iowan Old Style", Charter, Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your meetings, kept on your Mac.
styles.usage: Marketing headlines, onboarding, empty states. One per screen.

styles.name: title

styles.usage: Enhanced notes body: summary, decisions, action items. The reading face.

styles.name: note-heading

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and dialog titles, settings section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Transcribing on this Mac with Parakeet v3.
styles.usage: Default UI text, your own notepad, transcript lines.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, list item titles, emphasis in UI text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Speaker labels and section eyebrows, uppercase.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Transcript timestamps, citation targets, recording timer, model sizes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding (horizontal), gap between citation chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (horizontal, small), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between note sections' items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between note sections, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Notepad sheet padding, panel gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide windows, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citation chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the notepad sheet, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The recording pill and toggles. Echoes the rounded bars of the mark.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating elements only: popovers, the recording pill, dialogs. Cards on paper use line, not shadow.
